main_measure.name: mean unusual 7-bar move of long cases (return minus coin's normal 7-bar drift)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day taken together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with day-clustered t >= 2 and correlation > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: correlation of entry swing_rise post_pipeline_value with unusual move

decided_by: t between -2 and 2: inconclusive by the plan.
reading: situation = swing_rise last_history_value (recomputed from closes where missing) >= 2 with regime 'trending' as the profile filter; a case is the first long bet (forecast rise >= 2 points from its low on the long side) in each 7-bar grid cell of a window, day-clustered t uses per-day summed deviations with a G/(G-1) correction, and the correlation is Pearson.
